name: quoteplace-books
description: Books by QuotePlace authors, extracted from Open Library on 2026-10-30.

schema.author: site author name
schema.title: book title
schema.year: first publish year (for classics, the earliest edition/translation year)
schema.cover_id: Open Library cover id; cover URL is https://covers.openlibrary.org/b/id/<cover_id>-L.jpg (empty means no cover)
schema.ol: Open Library path; full URL is https://openlibrary.org followed by this path
schema.amazon_url: Amazon affiliate link, empty until filled
